caption: The disk moves data by DMA for 40 ms while the CPU runs the application. At 40 ms the disk interrupts; the CPU spends 5 ms taking the interrupt and 10 ms in the ISR, then the application resumes at 55 ms and runs to 100 ms.

spec.aria: The CPU runs an application until a disk interrupt at 40 ms, handles the interrupt for 15 ms, then resumes the application at 55 ms.
